what: Mitigated high and medium security vulnerabilities including read-time secret redactor, new API key patterns, and MCP input size limits
why: A security report identified a secret redactor bypass in reading memory, incomplete API key patterns (OpenAI sk-proj, Anthropic sk-ant-api03, unquoted export), and lack of parameter bounds in MCP.
learned: Sanitizing input during save is not enough; we must also sanitize fields during database retrieval to prevent exposing old secrets or unredacted fields. String and depth bounds must be enforced at the API/handler level to prevent denial of service and memory overflow in SQLite. Use distinct quote and no-quote regex patterns in Go's RE2 engine due to lack of backreferences.
author: Mario Sandoval (Sv Tech)
